by
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  let ⟨M, A⟩ := hf_infinity.isBoundedAtImInfty_iff.1 hf_infinity
  let ε := 1
  let δ := ε
  let hδ := UpperHalfPlane.tendsto_smul_atImInfty (by simp)
  let h_cont := hf_cont.continuous_at
  let h_closed := UpperHalfPlane.isCompactClosure
  let h_compact := h_closed.compact
  let h_image_compact := h_compact.image h_cont
  let h_finite := h_image_compact.finite_subcover
  let h_finite' := h_finite.map (fun τ => ‖f τ‖)
  let h_bound := h_finite'.bounded
  let C := max M (h_bound.upper_bound)
  constructor
  intro τ
  cases UpperHalfPlane.im_nonneg τ with im
  have h_im_ge_A : im ≥ A := by exact im.ge A
  have h_bound_1 : ‖f τ‖ ≤ M := by exact hf_infinity.2 h_im_ge_A
  have h_bound_2 : ‖f τ‖ ≤ h_bound.upper_bound := by exact h_bound.2 τ
  exact le_max_left C h_bound_1
